artifacts.name: setup-win
artifacts.notes: The installer a new user downloads: http://179.198.197.7/omni/dist/blob/setup-win A stub -- it fetches the current app-win build from this same API and sha256-verifies it, so it does NOT need rebuilding for each app release. Exists because a .zip makes Windows mark every extracted file with the Internet zone, which stopped the .NET assembly loader loading Python.Runtime.dll and killed the app on launch. Files an installer writes carry no such mark. Installs per-user to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\OmniExecutor -- no administrator. Version 3 (2026-09-02) points bootstrap at the new VPS 179.198.197.7. Version 2 (2026-08-22) replaces an existing install FILE BY FILE via bootstrap.replace_tree: version 1 could not replace a folder pinned by a live QEMU or window-lock and failed with WinError 183. REBUILD AND REPUBLISH THIS whenever installer.py or bootstrap.py changes -- the stub bundles both, and a fix left unbuilt is a fix that is not shipped.

artifacts.name: setup-mac
artifacts.notes: What a new Mac user downloads: http://179.198.197.7/omni/dist/blob/setup-mac A plain UDZO disk image holding the .app plus an /Applications symlink, built with hdiutil rather than create-dmg — create-dmg styles the window with Finder AppleScript, which needs a logged-in GUI session and times out over ssh. Unlike setup-win this is NOT a stub: it carries the build, so it has to be republished per release. The app inside is ad-hoc signed with no Team ID, so Gatekeeper refuses the first launch until the user right-clicks -> Open.

artifacts.name: offset-arceus-arm
artifacts.notes: Roblox 2.735.1138 (omniexec-2.735.1138-lock2.apk: pointer-capture gate + constant absolute position while captured), host-redirected to 179.198.197.7. Baked on the Mac on base 'arm' (LineageOS 23.2 rooted pair); matches the x86 offset's Roblox build. dest_name stays base_arm_data_offset_arceusremote.qcow2 so installed clients drop it where their paths.json already boots from.

artifacts.name: base-x86
artifacts.notes: x86 Bliss OS base set (base_x86.qcow2/.kernel/.initrd.img + data-template + devkit). Carries libndk_translation so the arm-only arceus APK runs. BASE v6 (2026-08-18): the baked /system/app/OmniKiosk was rebuilt from source. The previous bake predated launcher/src/com/omni/kiosk/SessionProvider.java, so its manifest declared a class its dex did not contain -- the kiosk crash-looped, no session cookie was delivered and no deep-link fired, i.e. every fresh install black-screened with no auto-login and no auto-join. Kernel and initrd are byte-identical to v5; only the system disk changed. The arceusremote offset is a /data overlay and is unchanged -- it did not need rebaking.

artifacts.name: qemu-portable-win
artifacts.notes: Pruned portable QEMU (x86_64 only: the three binaries omnidroid invokes, all DLLs, and share/ minus docs, icons and the non-x86 UEFI firmware). Exists so a fresh install needs NO administrator prompt -- the vendor NSIS installer is requireAdministrator, this is a zip into %LOCALAPPDATA%. The client prefers it over qemu-win whenever it is present.

artifacts.name: qemu-win
artifacts.notes: Official weilnetz w64 NSIS installer (~197 MB), served as a 302 rather than stored. omnidroid's ensure_qemu() silent-installs it with `<installer> /S /D=<dir>`. weilnetz prunes old dated builds, so re-pin this when it starts 404ing â€” doing it here fixes every client without a new release.

artifacts.name: adb-win
artifacts.notes: Google's official platform-tools zip, served as a 302 rather than stored. omnidroid/adb.py shells the BARE NAME 'adb', so a machine without it fails every guest command at CreateProcess; the client unpacks this into %LOCALAPPDATA%\OmniExec\platform-tools and prepends that to PATH. Deliberately the 'latest' alias, not a dated build — it is the one platform-tools URL Google has never moved.

artifacts.name: omnidroid-bundle
artifacts.notes: Handoff only (not in the stable manifest; fetch by name). omnidroid working tree with WIP: recovered X86_* constants, the OMNIDROID_CONFIG_PATH fix, and bundled Windows QEMU (qemu/*.exe) + prebuilt dist/omnidroid.exe. This is the omnidroid state the Windows session needs (origin/main lacks the WIP).

artifacts.name: arceus-apk
artifacts.notes: Handoff only (fetch by name). The retargeted arm64 arceus build to bake onto the x86 base as base_x86_data_offset_arceusremote.qcow2.

artifacts.name: app-win
artifacts.notes: Desktop app build. kind=app keeps it out of the first-boot runtime download plan; the client stages it, swaps it in and relaunches.

artifacts.name: app-mac
artifacts.notes: Desktop app build. kind=app keeps it out of the first-boot runtime download plan; the client stages it, swaps it in and relaunches. Zipped with `ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent` rather than push-app.mjs's `zip -qr`: the bundle holds 85 symlinks and zip would dereference every one, bloating the archive and breaking the ad-hoc signature.

artifacts.name: offset-arceus-x86-linux
artifacts.notes: Arceus X NEO 2.3.2 / Roblox 2.734.917, host-redirected to 179.198.197.7. Same blob as the Windows row — one x86 image serves both hosts.

artifacts.name: app-linux
artifacts.notes: Desktop app build for Linux (x86_64 ELF, one-dir). kind=app keeps it out of the first-boot runtime download plan. QEMU and adb are NOT bundled: Linux policy is system tooling from apt. Built without python3-tk, so the built-in VNC viewer (tkinter + PIL) is excluded from this build; every other feature is present.
